title: StablecoinX Float: Who Holds USDE Shares and What Can Trade
headline: How many StablecoinX shares can trade?
name: StablecoinX float and ownership review
description: About 79% of StablecoinX's 24.03 million Class A shares could trade freely on August 28, 2026. Who holds the rest, when lock-ups end and how much USDE traded.
imageAlt: Line chart of cumulative USDE trading volume from June 26 to October 8, 2026, reaching 19.97 times the 19,063,653 shares the resale prospectus counted as freely tradable
